budget.title: # Mova Budget Report
budget.final_tokens_sent: **Final tokens sent to the model: {{count}}** (after Sanitizer, Cache Layout Guard, and Circuit Breaker — see below for each stage's detail)
budget.tokenization_note1: Token counts are a local estimate computed with tiktoken-go — the same open-source library OpenAI itself publishes. Every calculation in this report runs on this machine: nothing in your project is sent anywhere to produce it.
budget.tokenization_note2: For OpenAI models, this count is typically an exact match to what the OpenAI API bills you for. For Claude and Gemini, no official local tokenizer is publicly available, so this report reuses the same encoding as a close approximation — real counts from those providers are usually very close, but can differ, especially for non-English text or dense code. See "Historical Token Accuracy" below for this project's own measured difference.
budget.token_cost_breakdown_note: This is where your token budget is actually going — one row per piece of the context declared in project.json (agents, skills, prompt, focus, memory), plus fixed engine overhead. Use it to see, in both tokens and dollars, exactly what is worth trimming first.
budget.important_note: These are estimates based on token counts computed locally and on the prices configured in config/prices.json. Real costs can vary depending on provider, model, caching, discounts, and commercial policies. This report is a tool to help you see where your token budget goes and what to optimize — it does not replace checking your actual invoice with each provider, and it is not a guarantee of exact pricing.
budget.deduplication_note: Mova Context automatically removed {{count}} duplicated paragraph(s) that appeared more than once across agents, skills, prompt, focus, and memory. This happens automatically on every run — no configuration needed, and no content is ever summarized or reworded, only exact repeats are removed.
budget.with_focus:
With focus (only the files selected in project.json):
Tokens: {{count}}
budget.no_savings: No savings here: focus adds about {{pct}}% formatting overhead instead. This happens when focus already covers the entire repository — there is nothing left to exclude. Savings appear once focus is narrowed to only the files that are actually relevant to the task, on a repository with more files than focus selects.
budget.focus_explainer: Focus is not automatic compression — nothing is summarized or rewritten. Focus simply gives the developer full control over exactly which files are sent to the model, instead of dumping the entire repository. Benefits: lower cost, less noise, better precision, more privacy, and more control over the project.
budget.status_over_budget: Status: OVER BUDGET. Sending this context to a model is blocked until it fits — this is enforced automatically on every `mova run`, `mova chat`, and MCP/HTTP call, never just a warning (see mova.local/budget.EnforceLimit).
budget.recommendation_biggest: - {{name}} is the largest piece of this context ({{count}} tokens) — trim it first in project.json.
budget.recommendation_use_focus: - Use `--focus` (or narrow an existing "focus" list) so only the files actually needed for this task are included.
budget.recommendation_remove_unused: - Remove agents/skills from project.json's "use" lists that this task does not need.
budget.recommendation_check_duplicates: - Check agents/skills/prompt for repeated paragraphs — Mova Context removes exact duplicates automatically, but only what it can find.
budget.recommendation_raise_limit: - Raise "budget": {"max_tokens": {{count}}} in project.json (or the task) only if this context size is genuinely intended.
budget.provider_diff_title: ### Why token counts differ between providers
budget.provider_diff_intro: This report uses one encoding ({{encoding}}, via tiktoken-go) for every provider, because Claude and Gemini do not publish a local tokenizer. In practice:
budget.provider_diff_openai: - OpenAI/GPT: this estimate is normally an exact or near-exact match, since tiktoken-go is OpenAI's own tokenizer.
budget.provider_diff_gemini: - Google Gemini: typically close, small differences come from how Gemini splits certain punctuation, code, and non-English text.
budget.provider_diff_claude: - Anthropic Claude: usually the largest gap, since Claude uses its own (unpublished) tokenizer, which tends to segment text somewhat differently.
budget.provider_diff_see_historical: See "Historical Token Accuracy" below — once real API calls have been recorded for this project, the deviation for each provider is measured directly instead of assumed.
budget.historical_accuracy_intro: Mova Budget compares local token estimation (tiktoken-go) with real cloud API usage collected from this project.
budget.historical_footer: Historical accuracy is automatically calibrated using previous cloud requests from this project. Actual costs may vary depending on provider billing policies and tokenizer updates.
budget.approx_total_clp: Approximate total in CLP (exchange rate {{rate}}): ${{clp}} CLP (using {{provider}} {{model}})
budget.sanitizer_intro: Mova Context removed repetitive noise from Focus/Memory before counting or sending anything — 100% deterministic, no AI involved, microseconds of work:
budget.sanitizer_lines_removed: - {{count}} repeated line(s)/header(s) collapsed (e.g. repeated log lines, duplicated file headers).
budget.sanitizer_blank_removed: - {{count}} run(s) of excess blank lines collapsed.
budget.sanitizer_comments_removed: - {{count}} line(s) of large comment blocks omitted (only when "strip_comments" is enabled).
budget.sanitizer_approx_savings: Approximate savings: ~{{tokens}} tokens (~{{chars}} characters) — already reflected in every count above.
budget.pii_masking_result: {{masked}} of {{scanned}} scanned token(s) in Focus/Memory matched the structural PII-shape threshold (config/policy.json) and were replaced with a deterministic `[PII_xxxxxxxx]` pseudonym before counting or sending anything.
budget.pii_masking_disclaimer: This is a heuristic, structural mitigation (word shape + Shannon entropy, no word lists) — **not** a legal anonymization or Ley 21.719/GDPR compliance guarantee. It does not detect 100% of PII (false negatives), and can also mask some non-PII tokens that share a similar structural shape, such as dates (false positives). It does not replace legal review, an internal privacy policy, or a compliance program. See docs/i18n/{es,en}/COMMANDS.md § PII Masking.
budget.cache_layout_intro: "cache_hint" is enabled: the system prompt sent to the model is laid out as a stable prefix (agents + skills + prompt) followed by everything that changes every run (timestamp, focus, memory) — this is what lets a Cloud provider's own prompt caching actually trigger.
budget.cache_prefix_fingerprint: Prefix fingerprint: `{{hash}}` — compare this value run to run; an unchanged fingerprint means the prefix is byte-identical and a real provider cache is likely to hit.
budget.cache_estimated_reuse: Estimated tokens reused on a cache hit: ~{{count}} (~90% of the static prefix — Anthropic's own published discount for cached input; other providers vary, see COMMANDS.md § Context Governance for the per-provider table).
budget.cache_below_minimum: Note: this prefix is under ~1,024 tokens, the approximate minimum several providers require before caching kicks in (the exact minimum varies by provider/model and changes over time) — caching may not activate yet for this project, but there is no downside to leaving "cache_hint" on.
budget.cache_probability_note: This increases the PROBABILITY of a cache hit — it does not guarantee one. Actual caching depends on the provider, the model, and whether you make another call using the same prefix again while the provider's cache window is still open.
budget.circuit_monthly_spend: Monthly spend: ${{spent}} / ${{limit}} ({{status}}) — tracked in mova-spend.json, resets automatically at the start of each calendar month.
budget.circuit_status_aborted: Status: {{message}} **This stops execution before anything is sent to a model** ("on_exceed": "abort").
budget.circuit_status_warn: Status: {{message}} This is a warning only ("on_exceed": "warn", the default) — execution continues.
budget.governance_summary_intro: Before vs. after the full pipeline (Sanitizer + Cache Layout Guard awareness + Circuit Breaker check):
budget.governance_summary_footer: These are estimates from the local tokenizer and config/prices.json — consistent and useful for comparing before/after, not a guarantee of what a provider will actually bill (see the Historical Accuracy section below for how close local estimates have run to real usage on this project).
